lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a multi-row horizontal lattice across the mid-lateral flank, with at least four distinct horizontal rows extending from the branchial region towards the caudal peduncle.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral surface, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity upper edges and shadowed ventral margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A minor irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin near its apex.
other_distinctive_markers: A transition in spot morphology is observed from high-density, micro-scale clusters on the cephalic region to larger, widely spaced circular blobs posterior to the gill slits.
